evidence.quote:
remember returns a receipt in
seconds

observations.why: Ratifying a contract that guarantees a receipt frames stability of process and mastery of reliable return as the goods being committed to.
The appeal is to security — work is not lost — positioning the contract as protecting what already exists.

evidence.quote:
the agent either polls the run or
gets the reaction piggybacked on a later call

observations.why: Framing the agent's choice between polling and piggybacking appeals to self-origination of pace and capability to manage the workflow.
